expectations.text: Bits 7-4 select the video matrix (screen RAM) base, in units of $0400 (1K) within the VIC bank
expectations.evidence: "Bits 7-4 (VM13–VM10): video matrix / screen base. Granularity 1 KB ($0400). 16 positions in bank."

expectations.text: Bits 3-1 select the character generator base, in units of $0800 (2K) within the bank
expectations.evidence: "Bits 3-1 (CB13–CB11): character generator base (text mode). Granularity 2 KB ($0800). 8 positions in bank."

expectations.text: In bitmap mode, bit 3 selects the bitmap base at $0000 or $2000 within the bank (8K granularity)
expectations.evidence: "only bit 3 (CB13) matters. Bitmap is 8 KB, base = bit3 * 8192 → offset $0000 or $2000"
"Bit 0: unused. Reads back 1 on real VIC-II."
